summary: Implemented Optional total support for Rich progress. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.total Optional, remaining/time_remaining return None when total unknown, no auto-finish without total, add_task accepts None, BarColumn pulses when total is None, MofN/Download/TotalFileSize columns render "?" instead of failing), rich/progress_bar.py (ProgressBar accepts None total and pulses), tests/test_progress.py (two new tests), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased entry). Test results: tests/test_progress.py 38 passed. Full suite (excluding tests/test_pretty.py, which fails collection before and after): 13 failures, identical to the untouched baseline; 585 passed vs 583 before. Nothing committed. Choices: update(total=None) still means "no change", so a total cannot be cleared back to unknown via update; "?" placeholder text is my own choice.
